clauses.text: An appeal must be received within 120 days of the denial date.
An appeal must name the claim and the denial reason, cite the policy clause relied on, and attach the record entries that support each point made.
A change to a modifier, a diagnosis pointer or an authorization number is made by corrected claim under policy QUIL-TF, not by appeal.
Once a claim for a service has been submitted, the plan does not accept a request for authorization of that service. The provider must use the appeal process instead.
An appeal of a denial with reason code 50 is decided by a plan clinician. The treating clinician may ask for a peer-to-peer discussion within 10 days of the denial date.
